rationale: Antigravity's round-2 revision 27603ea3 moves the clipboard marker from the primary session (which holds the control window) onto all seven linked agent clients without changing mouse policy, proves with completion-marker waits that the control window and an unrelated session never write the sink while every agent client does, keeps the owner copy-command preserved, and its recorded hook check:fast and test:e2e runs passed; the only trade-off is that agent windows viewed by attaching the primary session directly keep baseline behavior, which the standard per-agent owner terminals do not use.
